full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the 38th Batch of Guiding Cases

Fa [2023] No. 178

To: All High People's Courts of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

Upon deliberation and decision by the Adjudication Committee of the Supreme People's Court, the following five cases, including Liu Mougui's Criminal附带 Civil Public Interest Litigation for Illegal Mining (Guiding Cases No. 212-216), are hereby issued as the 38th batch of guiding cases for reference in adjudicating similar cases.

October 19, 2023
